messages:
alex: Heads-up: CI failed during the state move for gpu-pool (s3 backend). error: backend key not found after rename. anyone seen this?

maria: saw it. backup job moved key from 'env/prod/terraform.tfstate' to 'env/prod/state-v2.tfstate' yesterday. Terraform init in CI still pointed at old key. :facepalm:

infra-bot: Lock created on dynamo-table 'tfstate-locks' by alex@ci-runner for 15m (ID: lock-0a9c)

sam: the problem is the Dynamo lock remained and CI retried with old key -> Dynamo entry refers to old key, so apply can't acquire against the new key. terraform plan hangs at 'Acquiring state lock...'

maria: I tried `terraform init -backend-config="key=env/prod/state-v2.tfstate"` locally and `terraform state pull` gives 404 from s3. but `aws s3 ls` shows file exists at path 'env/prod/state_v2.tfstate' (underscore vs dash mismatch from the migration script)

alex: oh, the rename script used sed on filenames and replaced '-' with '_' by mistake. Sigh.

jing: quick mitigation: remove the dynamo lock with `terraform force-unlock lock-0a9c` then copy the s3 object to a key matching the config: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-terraform/env/prod/state_v2.tfstate s3://redwood-terraform/env/prod/state-v2.tfstate` and re-run init

sam: caution: force-unlock while CI is running can cause competing writers. CI jobs are idle now but we should be careful. Also the Dynamo TTL has been flapping; looks like the lock renewer crashed and left stale locks.

devops-oncall: I'll escalate: stopping CI runners for that repo, will run force-unlock then perform a two-way copy (both keys) and re-run a smoke plan. ETA 20m. :thumbsup:

maria: also added a sanity check to the migration script to fail if it detects '-' vs '_' conversions and added a unit test. Opening PR now.

alex: post-mortem action items: 1) runbook for state move including lock drain; 2) CI check to validate backend key after rename; 3) small script to reconcile s3 keys by checksum, not just name. assigning to infra-ops.

infra-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-042 state-key-mismatch during s3 rename. linked to PR#812

sam: thanks all. lmk if you need pair on the unlock.
